总 则 
General 
 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and scope 
1.1 为履行《2006 年海事劳工公约》，落实《海事劳工符合声明》所阐述的各项责任和义务，
本公司特制订本手册。 
This manual is to carry out 2006 Maritime Labour Convention and fulfill the duties and obligations 
defined by Declaration Of Maritime Labour compliance. 
1.2 本手册适用于本公司及所管理的船舶和在所管理船舶上工作的船员。 
This manual applies to the company, ships owned by the company, and seafarers working on board the 
ships. 
2.0 制订依据 
Basis 
本手册的主要依据是《2006 年海事劳工公约》（MLC2006）和国际劳工组织（ILO）、
世界卫生组织（WHO）、国际海事组织（IMO）等国际组织的有关公约及船旗国主管
当局为履行MLC2006 而制定的法律或规定、主管当局公布的海事通告或其他措施。 
This manual is compiled according to 2006 Maritime Labour Convention (MLC2006) and other related 
conventions composed by International Labour Organization (ILO), World Health Organization (WHO) 
and International Maritime Organization（IMO）, laws and regulations specified by competent authority of 
the flag state, maritime bulletins and other actions published by competent authority. 
3.0 一般义务和要求 
    General obligation and requirement  
3.1 落实“以人为本”方针，促进航运事业发展，维护船员合法权益，构建和谐劳动关系，
实现船员“体面劳动”。 
Observe People-Oriented policy, facilitate the development of shipping business, protect legitimate 
interest of seafarers, construct harmonious labour relationship, achieve Decent Work of seafarers. 
3.2 贯彻结社自由和承认有效集体谈判权利；消除所有形式的强迫和强制劳动；有效废除
童工劳动；消除就业和职业方面的歧视等基本原则。 
Carry out basic principles of freedom of association and the effective recognition of the right to collective 
bargaining; the elimination of all forms of forced or compulsory labour; the effective abolition of child 
labour and the elimination of discrimination in respect of employment and occupation. 
3.3 确保每一在船工作船员均有权享受符合安全标准且受保护的工作场所；公平的就业条
件；体面的船上工作和生活条件；健康、医疗、福利措施及其他形式的社会保障。 
Ensure that every seafarer onboard has the right to a safe and secure workplace that complies with safety 
standards, fair terms of employment, decent working and living conditions on board ship, health 
protection, medical care, welfare measures and other forms of social protection. 
3.4 本手册将详细说明《海事劳工符合声明 第Ⅱ部分》（DMLC PART Ⅱ ）中的有关船员
招募和资质、工作和待遇、社会保障、生活设施和饮食、健康和安全等16 项措施的实
施要求，符合MLC2006 标题一至标题五中的规定及标准A 要求，并充分考虑导则B
的要求。 
This manual will describe 16 implementation requirements relating to seafarer recruitment and 
qualification, work and treatment, social security, life facilities and catering, health and safety declared in 
Declaration of Maritime Labour Compliance Part II in details, to conform to the rules of title 1 to 5 and 
standard A of the MLC2006, and take into full consideration of requirements of guideline B.

第一章 
招募和资质 
 Chapter 01  Recruitment and Qualification 
1.1 最低年龄  
    Minimum age 
本公司仅招募年龄在18 周岁以上的船员，包括实习船员。船员部通过核查本船海员的
海员证、船员服务簿，确保其年满18 周岁。 
The company only recruits seafarers, including petty seafarers who are above the age of 18. The 
deployment personal of the crew department is through verification boarding seafarers’ passport and 
identity documents to ensure that they are more than 18 years old. 
1.2 船员体检 
Medical examination for seafarer 
1.2.1 体检要求 
Requirements of medical examination 
1.2.1.1 船员在上船工作前应持有主管当局认可且有效的《健康证明书》。 
Prior to beginning to work on ship，seafarers shall hold valid medical certificate Health Certificate 
which is acknowledged by competent authority.  
1.2.1.2 船员健康检查标准应遵循国际劳工组织 (ILO)及世界卫生组织 (WHO)有关《船员
上船工作前和定期体格健康检查的实施指南》和主管当局的有关要求，包括其任
何修订版本以及ILO、IMO 及WHO 出版的任何其他适用的导则。 
Medical fitness examinations of seafarer shall follow the ILO/WHO Guidelines for Conducting 
Pre-sea and Periodic Medical Fitness Examinations for Seafarers and requirements of competent 
authority，including any revised versions，and any other applicable international guidelines published 
by the ILO, IMO or WHO. 
1.2.1.3 体检证书必须由经有资质的体检单位中合格医师签发，所有体检证书须有体检单
位盖章，合格医师签字后方能生效。 
The medical certificate shall be issued by a duly qualified medical practitioner. All medical 
certif1cates shall be sealed by medical examination authority and signed by the qualified medical 
practitioner otherwise it will be invalid.  
1.2.1.4 船员《健康证明书》须特别载明： 
Seafarer Health Certificate shall state in particular that： 
该船员的听力和视力均符合岗位要求； 
 The hearing and sight of the seafarer are all satisfactory to the work to be performed 
该船员末患有任何由于在海上工作而可能会而加重、或使其变得不适合从事此种
工作、或威胁船上其他人员健康的疾患。 
The seafarer concerned is not suffering from any medical condition likely to be aggravated by 
service at sea or to render the seafarer unfit for such service or to endanger the health of other 
persons on board. 
1.2.1.5 船员《健康证明书》的有效期不超过二十四个月。 
Seafarers’ Health Certificate shall be valid for a maximum period of 24 months. 
1.2.1.6 船员的色觉视力证书最长有效期为六年。 
A certification of color vision shall be valid for a maximum period of six years.  
  
1.2.2 体检流程 
    Medical examination process 
1.2.2.1 船员在上船前，须经具有资质的体检单位中的合格医师进行健康体检经检查身  
体健康状况适合履行其海上职责，否则不得上船工作。

Prior to beginning to work on ship, seafarer shall be examined by qualified medical practitioner of 
qualified medical examination authority. Seafarers shall not work on ship unless they are certified as 
medically fit to perform their duties.   
1.2.2.2 公司负责对船员《健康证明书》进行审核并对有效期进行跟踪管理。 
The company shall be responsible for reviewing the seafarer Health Certificate and following the 
period of validity.  
1.2.2.3 船员上船前健康检查一次不合格者,公司允许给予由另一位独立的医师或独立的鉴
定人做进一步检查的机会，避免因误检或其他原因影响船员上船机遇。 
Prior to beginning to work on ship, seafarers that have been refused a certificate shall be given the 
opportunity to have a further examination by another independent medical practitioner or appraiser, 
to avoid losing work opportunity because of mistake or other issues. 
1.2.2.4 船员在上船健康检查时，有义务将本人健康情况如实向检查医疗机构反映，不得
隐瞒病情或用药物掩盖病状、或用其他方法骗取医生对《健康证明书》的签发。 
Seafarer shall have an obligation to report the health status to medical examination institution 
truthfully, gaining the Health Certificate by holding back the truly condition or masking symptoms 
by drugging, or other ways is forbidden. 
1.2.2.5 《健康证明书》应由船员本人随身携带，上船后即交给船长或其指定的人员保管，
船长或其指定的人员须审核船员《健康证明书》内的签发批注及有效期。 
Health Certificate shall be carried with the seafarer, after boarding, the certif1cate shall be kept by 
master or authorized person by the master. The master or authorized person by the master shall 
review the annotation and expiry date of the Health Certificate.  
1.2.2.6 船长或其指定的人员须每季度对本船船员《健康证明书》的有效期进行检查，对
即将到期船员应及时与港口代理联系安排船员到合格医疗卫生机构进行体检并上
报公司船员部。 
The master or authorized person by the master shall check the expiry date of seafarers' Health 
Certificate every quarter, while seafarer's Health Certificate is at the expiration, port agency shall be 
contacted in time to arrange the seafarers concerned to conduct medical examination in a qualified 
medical institution, and related information shall be reported to the crew department. 
1.2.2.7 如果某航行途中证书到期，该证书应继续有效至该船员能够从合格医师那里取得
体检证书的下一停靠港，延续时间不超过3 个月。 
If the period of validity of a certificate expires in the course of a voyage，the certificate shall 
continue in force until the next port of call where the seafarer can obtain a medical certificate from a 
qualified medical practitioner, provided that the period shall not exceed three months. 
1.2.2.8 在紧急情况下，本公司需向船旗国主管机关申请，以便获准未持有有效检合格证
书的海员工作至其能够从合格的医师那里获得一份体检合格证书的下一停靠港，
条件是所允许的期限保证不超过3 个月且该海员持有一份最近过期的体检合格证
书。 
In urgent cases, the Company shall apply to the competent Authority for permitting a seafarer to 
work without a valid medical certificate until the next port of call, where the seafarer can obtain   a 
medical certificate from a qualified medical practitioner, provided that the period of        
permission granted does not exceed 3 months and the seafarer concerned is in possession of an 
recently expired medical fitness certificate. 
1.3 培训和资格.  
Training and qualifications 
1.3.1 被招募的船员应经过船员基本安全等STCW 公约要求的培训，满足STCW 公约的持
证要求后方能上船工作。 
Employed seafarer shall be trained on basic safety knowledge and obtain the registered seafarer

1.3.2 船员证书 
Seafarer certificate 
1.3.2.1 船员证书是指国家海事主管机构签发的证明船员身份、适岗能力、培训合格证明
及记载船上工作资历的证明文件，分别是海员证、护照、船员服务簿、适任证书、
专业培训合格证书等。 
Seafarer certificate is a proof document to prove the identity, professional competency, qualification 
after training and work experience on board of a seafarer, which is issued by national maritime 
competent authority, such as seafarer certificate, passport, identity document, competency certificate 
and professional training certificate and other certificates. 
1.3.2.2 船员上船须带齐所有证书。 
When getting to board ship, seafarers shall carry all the certificates to prove their identity and 
professional competency. 
1.3.2.3 船员证书记载的姓名、出生年月必须与持证人相一致。 
The name and date of birth recorded on the certificate shall be consistent with the certif1cate holder. 
1.3.2.4 船员证书须妥善保管，不得任意涂改、伪造或变更。 
Seafarer certificate shall be kept carefully, prevented from altering, forging or changing.  
1.3.3 持证要求 
Requirements for the certificate holder 
1.3.3.1 所有在船船员须持有海员证、船员服务簿和个人安全专业培训合格证书。 
All seafarers shall hold seafarer certificate, seafarer identity document and personal professional 
safety training certificate. 
1.3.3.2 在船船长、高级船员和值班水手、值班机工须持有与其所服务的船舶航区、种类、
等级或主机类别和所担任的职务相符的有效适任证书和专业培训合格证书。 
Ship master, officer, watch keeping seamen and watch keeping motormen shall hold valid 
competency certificate and professional training certif1cate which are appropriate to the sailing zone, 
type, classif1cation of the ship, type of the main engine and the duty performing. 
1.3.3.3 在本船工作的船员，还须持有船旗国主管当局规定的相关证书。 
All seafarers on board ship shall hold related certificates specified by the competent authority of flag 
state. 
1.3.4   证书保管 
Reserving of certificate 
1.3.4.1 船员派遣公司负责为每个船员建立证件档案，负责办理自有船员证书的申办、更
换、补办及证书获取后的建档和证书信息的输入。 
The crew dispatch company shall establish a certificate archive for every seafarer, and 
shall be responsible for applying, updating, reapplying for seafarer certificate, filing the 
certificates, and inputting information of the certificate into system. 
1.3.4.2 船员派遣公司负责对即将安排上船的船员证书审核，确保所派船员的证书及签证
与船舶岗位、船旗国及驶往港口国要求相符一致。 
The crew dispatch company shall review certificates of seafarers who are beginning to work on 
ship, to ensure the certificate and visa of designated seafarer are complying with the requirements of 
position, flag state and destined port. 
1.3.4.3 船员本人上船前须审核持有的证书是否齐全、有效，证书记载的信息是否与实际
一致，上船后应交船长或其指定的人员保管。 
Prior to beginning to work on ship, seafarers shall review if their certificates are completed and valid, 
and if the information recorded is consistent with reality. After getting on board, the certificates shall 
be kept by master or authorized person by the master.

1.3.4.4 船长或其指定人员负责对本船船员的证书验收、保管。 
Master or authorized person by the master shall be responsible for verifying and keeping the 
seafarers' certificates. 
1.3.4.5 船员在船服务资历由船长负责在其《船员服务簿》中予以记录。 
Seafarers' work experience on board ship shall be recorded onto Seafarer Service Record by master. 
1.3.5 证书的有效性 
Validity of certificate 
公司船员部应定期审核证书的有效期，保证所有在船船员的证书在有效期内，海员
证、护照的有效期不少于六个月。船长应每季度检查本船船员的证书有效期，检查
结果报公司船员部。 
The deployment personal of the crew department shall be responsible for checking the validity of 
seafarers’ certificates regularly, to ensure all the seafarers’ certificates are within the period of validity, 
the validity of seafarer’s certificates and passports is not less than 6 months. The master should review 
the expiry date of all seafarers’ certificate onboard each quarter and report the results thereof to the 
crew department. 
1.4 招募和安置 
Employ and placement 
1.4.1 本公司所聘用的船员通过直接招募或公司指定的具备招募资质的船员招募机构获得。 
All employed seafarers shall be employed by direct recruitment, or through the designated and 
qualified recruitment agencies. 
1.4.2 根据公司发展需要，招募各航海院校的航海类专业毕业生为实习船员；招募持有船员
注册证书专业培训合格证书及相应资历的人员为正式船员。 
In response to the needs of company development, graduating students from navigation specialty of 
colleges and academies will be employed as petty seafarers as well as the seafarers who hold the 
registered seafarer certificate, competency certificate, professional training certificate, and with relevant 
working experiences will be employed as official seafarers. 
1.4.3 凡新招募船员初次上船前，须参加公司举办的熟悉职责培训。 
Prior to the first sailing, new seafarers shall attend the train on safety knowledge and familiarization of 
duty. 
1.4.4 遵守成员国与船旗国规定建立保护制度，补偿海员因招聘和安置服务或海员就业协议
规定的相关船东未能履行其对海员的义务而可能遭受的金钱损失，并确保海员在受雇
之前或受雇过程中被告知他们在该制度下的权利。 
Establish protection regimes in accordance with Member states and flag states, to compensate seafarers 
for monetary loss that they may incur as a result of the failure of a recruitment and placement service or 
the relevant shipowner under the seafarers’ employment agreement to meet its obligations to them, and 
ensure that seafarers are informed, prior to or in the process of engagement, of their rights under that 
system.

Chapter 02  Conditions of Employment 
2.1 就业协议 
Employment agreement 
2.1.1 公司依照国家相关法律，《国际海事劳工公约》以及船旗国的相关要求，制订本公司
《船员上船就业协议》。 
The company prepare the Seafarers' Employment Agreement according to related requirements of 
related regulatory，MLC and the flag state.  
2.1.2 《船员上船就业协议》的基本内容 
       Content of the Seafarers' Employment Agreement：  
 
船员的国籍、全名、出生日期、出生地、民族等： 
Nationality，full name，date of birth， place of birth，and ethnic group of the seafarer； 
 公司的名称和地址； 
Name and address of the company； 
 
签订就业协议的地点和日期； 
Place and date of signing employment agreement； 
 
船员将担任的职务； 
Duty that the seafarer is going to perform； 
 
船员的工资待遇； 
Wages and treatment； 
 
带薪年假的计算天数； 
Calculation of paid annual leave； 
 
协议的终止及其终止条件 
Termination of engagement and terms of termination； 
 
船员的社会保障： 
Social security； 
 
船员获得遣返的权利； 
Entitlement of repatriation； 
      ● 确保海员在船期间其家属能够获得信息并富有同情心处理且不收费用。   
        Ensure that requests for information by families of seafarers are dealt with promptly and 
sympathetically and at no cast. and 
     ● 确保船员所在船上的劳动条件符合船东与海员代表组织所签订的集体谈判协议。 
       Verifying that labour condition on ships where seafarers are placed are in conformity   
with applicable collective bargaining agreements.  
 
其他事项。 
Other issues 
2.1.3 《船员上船就业协议》签订流程: 
The Seafarers' Employment Agreement signing process: 
2.1.3.1 船员上船工作前，须与船舶船东签订就业协议。如船东和管理公司签署的《BIMCO
管理协议》中包括船员管理，管理公司可代表船东签署就业协议。               
Prior to beginning to work on ship, seafarer shall sign the Seafarers' Employment Agreement with the 
ship owner. In case of the 《Standard ship management agreement》 signed between the shipowner and 
the ship management company includes the crew management, the ship management company on 
behalf of the shipowner shall sign the Seafarers' Employment Agreement of Crew.

2.1.3.2 《船员上船就业协议》确定公司和船员各自的权益和义务、船员的工作时间、薪酬
待遇等。 
The Seafarers' Employment Agreement determines the rights and obligations of the company and the 
seafarer, hours of work, wages and treatment. 
2.1.3.3 公司与每位船员在签订《船员上船就业协议》时，应给予充足的时间让船员有机会
对《船员上船就业协议》进行审查和征询意见，在充分理解了其权利和义务及自愿情
况下签署。 
When signing the Seafarers' Employment Agreement with seafarer, the company shall give sufficient 
time to allow the seafarer to review the terms of the agreement, and ensure the agreement is signed 
under the circumstance that the seafarer has been sufficiently aware of their rights and obligations. 
2.1.3.4 公司和船员本人应各持有一份经签字的船员《船员上船就业协议》。 
A copy of signed Seafarers ' Employment Agreement’ shall be held by the company and the seafarer. 
2.1.3.5 船上保留一份中英文对照的《船员上船就业协议》。 
Bilingual Seafarers' Employment Agreement in Chinese and English shall be maintained on ship. 
2.1.3.6 海员就业协议在由于海盗或者针对船舶的武装劫持等行为导致的海员被劫持期间的持续有效，不
管这个海员就业协议是否已经到期或者任何一方申明暂停或者终止合同。 
The seafarer’s employment agreement shall continue to have effect while a seafarer is held captive on or 
off the ship as a result of acts of piracy or armed robbery against ships, regardless of whether the date 
fixed for its expiry has passed or either party has given notice to suspend or terminate it. For the purpose 
of this paragraph, the term: 
2.1.3.7 一旦海员因海盗或者针对船舶的武装劫持等行为导致海员被俘在船或被劫持离船，其海员就业协
议及其相关集体协议或适用的国内法中的工资和其他权利，包括家庭汇款，在海员整个被劫持期
间也应该持续地得到支付，直至海员被释放或者被适当的遣返。一旦海员在劫持期间死亡，该协
议有效至适用国内法律法规所确定的死亡日期。该条款中的海盗和武装劫持船舶与《2006 海事
劳工公约》规则 A2.1 第 7 段的含义一致。 
Where a seafarer is held captive on or off the ship as a result of acts of piracy or armed robbery against 
ships, wages and other entitlements under the seafarers employment agreement, relevant collective 
bargaining agreement or applicable national laws, including the remittance of any allotments , shall 
continue to be paid during the entire period of captivity and until the seafarer is released and duly 
repatriated or, where the seafarer dies while in captivity, until the date of death as determined in 
accordance with applicable national laws or regulations. The terms piracy and armed robbery against 
ships shall have the same meaning as in MLC Standard A2.1, paragraph 7. 
2.2  作息时间和休假 
    Hours of work and rest，and leave 
2.2.1 作息时间 
Hours of work and rest 
2.2.1.1 船员在船工作期间，以每日工作8 小时为标准的综合计算工作制。 
When seafarers work on board, the standard of work hours is 8 hours a day. 
2.1.2.2 安排船员休息时间应符合以下要求： 
Following requirements shall be met when arranging hours of rest： 
1) 在任何24 小时时段内船员休息时间不得少于10 小时；且在任何7 天时间内船员
休息时间不得少于77 小时； 
   Minimum hours of rest shall not be less than 10 hours in any 24-hour period, and minimum hours of 
rest shall not be less than 77 hours in any 7-day period. 
    2) 休息时间最多可分为两段，其中一段至少要有6 小时，且相连的两段休息时间的间
隔不得超过14 小时。 
Hours of rest may be divided into no more than two periods, one of which shall be at least six hours in

With regard to the requirements 1) and 2), if the laws and regulations of the flag state permit 
exceptions to the limits set out, it shall be carried out according to the laws and regulations of the flag 
state. 
2.1.2.3 本手册的任何规定不得妨碍船长出于船舶、船上人员或货物的紧急安全需要， 或
出于帮助海上遇险的其他船舶或人员的目的而要求一名海员从事任何时间工作的权
利。为此，船长可中止工作时间或休息时间的安排，要求一名海员从事任何时间的必
要工作，直至情况恢复正常。一旦情况恢复正常，船长应尽快地确保所有在计划安排
的休息时间内从事工作的海员获得充足的休息时间。 
Nothing in this manual shall be deemed to impair the right of the master of a ship to require a seafarer 
to perform any hours of work necessary for the immediate safety of the ship, persons on board or cargo, 
or for the purpose of giving assistance to other ships or persons in distress at sea. Accordingly, the 
master may suspend the schedule of hours of work or hours of rest and require a seafarer to perform 
any hours of work necessary until the normal situation has been restored. As soon as practicable after 
the normal situation has been restored, the master shall ensure that any seafarers who have performed 
work in a scheduled rest period are provided with an adequate period of rest. 
2.2.2 工作休息记录 
Records of work and rest 
2.2.2.1 部门长应提前作好工作安排，填妥“船上工作安排表”，经船长签字批准后张贴在
船上易于进入的地点。 
Department head shall pre-arrange the work schedule and fill in the Table of Shipboard Working 
Arrangements (as per appendix 3), and post it in an easily accessible place after approved by master. 
2.2.2.2 大副、大管轮应做好船员工作小时和休息时间的记录，填妥“船员值班（工作）/
休息时间记录表”，每个月结束本月记录后由船长或授权人（部门长）和船员本人对
该记录核对无误后签字，保证有关工作小时和休息时 间的规定得以执行，以备主管
机关或港口国检察官的检查。“船员值班（工作）/休息时间记录表”正本由船长保存，
海员应得到一份由船长或船长授权人以及海员本人签字认可的有关其本人记录的副
本。 
The chief officer and second engineer officer shall record the hours of work and rest of seafarers and fill 
in the Table for Record of Hours of Work or Hours of Rest of Seafarers (as per appendix 4), the master 
or the authorized person and the seafarer shall check and sign on the record at the end of every month, 
ensure provisions pertaining to hours of work and rest are followed, and for future reference for 
checking by competent authority or port inspector. the Table for Record of Hours of Work or Hours of 
Rest of Seafarers shall keep by master, the seafares shall receive a copy of the records pertaining to 
them which shall be endorsed by the master ,or a person authorized by the master, and by the seafares. 
2.2.2.3 “船上工作安排表”和“船员值班（工作）/休息时间记录表”不准用铅笔填写。

2.2.3 休假工资 
Leave pay 
船员年休假工资按在船工作每月累积2.5 天计算。 
The annual leave with pay entitlement shall be calculated on the basis of 2.5 calendar days per month of 
employment on shipboard. 
2.3  工资 
Wages 
2.3.1 在船工资 
Onboard wages 
2.3.1.1 船员在船工作期间，按照上船前与公司签订的《船员上船就业协议》获得全额的工
资报酬。 
During the period of work on board ship, seafarers shall be paid for their work in full according to the 
Seafarers' Employment Agreement. 
2.3.1.2 船员工资标准参考《国际海事劳工公约》、船旗国以及中国的法律所规定的最低工
资标准。 
The seafarers' onboard wage standard should refer to the minimum wage stipulated in the MLC and 
provisions of national law. 
2.3.1.3 出于计算工资之目的，每日正常工作时间不超过八小时，基本工资涵盖的每周正常
工作时间不超过四十八小时。休息时间按照STCW 公约相关的规定执行。 
For the purpose of calculating wages, Normal work hours shall not exceed 8 hours per day and normal 
hours covered by basic wages shall not exceed 48 hours per week. The rest hours will be regulated as 
per the requirement of STCW.  
2.3.1.4 加班指超出正常工作时间之外工作的时间。出于计算加班之目的，每小时加班费率
不低于正常工作时间对应的基本工资率的1.25 倍。 每月固定加班费按照每月104 小
时计算，如果加班时间超出104 小时，将按照实际发生的时间计算加班费。 
Overtime means the time worked in excess of the normal hours of works. For the purpose of calculating 
overtime, he hourly rate for overtime works should be not less than one and one quarter times the basic 
rate corresponding to the normal hours of works. Guaranteed overtime for crews calculated at 104 hours 
per month, If the overtime hours exceed 104 hours, it shall be calculated according to the actual 
occurrence. 
2.3.1.5 公共假期补贴按照船旗国公约有关规定执行。  
Public Holidays entitlement will be governed by the convention provisions of flag state as mentioned in 
force. 
2.3.1.6 货币兑换率不得对海员不利。 
Currency exchange rate shall be not unfavorable to the seafarers. 
2.3.2 工资发放 
Wages release 
2.3.2.1 船员在船工作期间按月发放工资，。 
During period of work on board ship, seafarer shall be paid once a month. 
2.3.2.2 乙方有权将其收入转给其家人或乙方指定的人员，甲方应为此提供便利。甲方支付
乙方的每月工资或提供家汇便利，不收取手续费。 
The seafarer shall be entitled to transmit their earnings to their families or person nominated by the 
seafarers and the Party A shall provide the seafarer with facilities to do so. There will be no charge by 
the Part A to the seafarer’s monthly wages. There will be no charge by the Part A to the seafarer for 
providing him with this facility.

2.3.2.3 公司发放的船员工资清单需由船员签字确认。 
The wages paid by company should sign by seafarers every month. 
2.3.2.4 船上发放其他收入。船长或指定人员负责编制发放清单，由船员签收。 
Other pay such as sailing benefit will be released on board ship. Master or authorized person shall be 
responsible for preparing release notes and seafarers shall sign for the pay. 
2.4  社会保障 
Social security     
2.4.1 根据国家法律规定，为船员缴纳养老、医疗、失业、工伤等社会保障。 
According to provisions of national law, the company pay social security to provide old-age，medical 
care, un-employment, employment injury Protection.  
2.4.2 公司每月将为船员缴纳的以及从船员本人工资中扣缴的社会保险费用及时通过银行
汇入政府相关部门指定的账户。 
     Social security including company's contributions and statutory deduction from seafarer's wages will be 
transferred to the account specified by government department in time every month. 
2.4.3 船员本人可登陆政府相关部门网站或持本人有效身份证件到政府相关部门，查看本人
的养老、医疗等社会保险缴纳情况。 
     Seafarer can log on related government website or visit the government department by holding valid 
personal ID to consult the contribution status of old-age, medical care benefit. 
2.4.4 公司及时将政府有关部门关于船员缴纳社会保险的有关消息，发至船舶给予船员及时
了解。 
     Related social security information from government will sent to ship via E-mail in time so as to be 
known by the seafarers. 
2.4.5 公司向声誉良好的船东互保协会或保险公司投保，以确保船员在疾病、伤残、残废时
得到赔偿。公司不向船员收取此项投保费用，并将投保情况书面告知船员。 
     The company takes out insurance to shipowners mutual assurance association or insurance company 
who has good reputation, to ensure that seafarers will be compensated when they are sick, maimed or 
injury. Seafarers will not pay for this insurance and have the access to information of the insurance. 
2.5  遣返 
    Repatriation 
2.5.1 船员在下列情况下应享有遣返权利： 
     Seafarers shall have the entitlement of repatriation in the following circumstances： 
 船员在船工作聘用期满，且船舶短时期内无法回国内时： 
In the event of the seafarers' employment agreement being expired and the ship cannot repatriate in a 
short time. 
 船舶在国外期间，船员因受伤或患病，经船医或当地医院诊断，短时问难于治愈
又不能随船时； 
While aboard, in the event of illness or injury, after diagnosing by ship doctor or local hospital, the 
diagnosis shows the seafarer will not be cured in a short time and is unfit to living on board any 
more. 
 船员不具备履行船上岗位职责能力时； 
In the event of seafarer being unable to perform duty on board. 
 船员因家庭发生重大变故需本人提前离船的； 
In the event of seafarer being going to leave in advance by reason of significant family 
Misfortune. 
 未经船员同意，船舶驶往由国家法律或条例限定的战乱、疫区区域； 
In the event of a ship being bound for a war or plague zone, as defined by national laws or 
regulations, to which the seafarer does not consent to go.

2.5.2 遣返的安排 
Arrangement of repatriation 
2.5.2.1 船员遣返回国地点为公司所在地或船员居住地。 
The destination of repatriation should be the company location or the seafarers' country of residence 
船员申请遣返，应提前 15 天向公司报告 (紧急情况除外)，以便委托代理办理签证、
机票等事宜。 
Where applying for repatriation, seafarer shall report to company 15 days in advance (excluding 
emergency), so the company can unhurriedly consign agency to deal with visa and air ticket. 
2.5.2.2 船员遣返乘坐的交通工具费用、旅途中的食宿费及30 公斤行李费均由用公司承担。 
The company shall bear the cost of passage to the destination, accommodation and food in travelling 
and transportation of 30 kg of the seafarers' personal luggage. 
2.5.2.3 船员遣返自离船至回到国内第一机场期间，其工资按在船标准发放。 
Pay and allowances from the moment the seafarers leave the ship until they reach the first domestic 
airport shall be released to seafarer according to the level on board ship. 
2.5.3 公司或船员单方面提前终止本协议时，皆须预先通知对方。且双方的最短预先通知期
皆不得短于15 天。 
2.6 Where unilaterally terminates the agreement by the company or the seafarer，it shall be 
informed in advance to the other party. The minimum notice period shall not be shorter 
than 15 days.船舶配员水平 
Manning levels for the ship 
2.6.1 公司根据主管机关签发的《最低安全配员证书》及MLC2006 要求，从数量和资格角
度为船舶配备充足的海员，确保在各种操作情况下船舶及其人员的安全、高效操作和
保安方面的要求，必要时增加船舶配员。 
According to the requirements of "Minimum Safe Manning Certificate” Issued by the competent 
authorities and the MLC2006, the company shall ensure to be equipped with sufficient seafarers for ship 
In terms of size and qualifications, to meet the requirements for the ship and its crew safety, efficient 
operation and security in all operating conditions, when necessary, to increase the manning of ships. 
2.6.2 公司在确定船舶配员水平时，应考虑到主管机关为避免或最大限度减少过度超时工作
从而确保充分休息和限制疲劳的有关规定。船员部负责海员派船事宜，船长有问题应
及时报告船员部。公司（船员部）也将积极参与主管机关调查和解决任何关于船上配
员水平的申诉或争议。 
When determining manning levels of the ship, the company should consider the related regulations of 
the authorities, which in order to avoid or minimize excessive hours of work, and to ensure sufficient 
rest and to restrict fatigue. The Crew Department is responsible for ship manning. any doubt should be 
reported in time to the Crew Department by the Master on board. The company (Crew Dept.) shall 
actively participate in the competent authorities for investigation and settlement of any complaints or 
disputes related to on-board ship manning.

第三章 生活设施和饮食 
Chapter 03 Life Facilities and Catering 
 
3.1 起居舱室 
Accommodation 
3.1.1 船舶的起居舱室符合《2006 年海事劳工公约》中有关要求（如适用），或船舶应持有
主管当局签发且有效的《船员舱室设备检验证书》（如船籍国要求）。 
Accommodation of ship is in compliance with requirements of the 2006 Maritime Labor 
Convention，where applicable, or the Seafarer Accommodation  Equipment Qualified 
Certificate issued by the competent authority shall be available where required by the Flag 
State. 
3.1.2 船员起居舱室包括卧室、办公室、盥洗室、餐厅、厨房、会议室、医务室、娱乐室、
吸烟室、健身房、洗衣房、烘衣间、更衣室以及其它生活区公共场所。每名船员须有
独立的卧室。餐具包括盘子、杯子及其他器皿，必须使用易于清洗的材料。公司需为
船员提供干净的餐具。公司需向海员免费提供毛巾、肥皂、卫生纸。公司需向海员提
供方便的洗衣服务，包括：洗衣机、烘干机或充分通风和加热的房间、电熨斗、熨板。
医务室单独设置，专供医疗使用，不得用于其他用途。 
Seafarer accommodation includes sleeping room, office, toilet, mess room, galley, conference room, 
hospital accommodation, recreation room, smoking room, gymnasium, washhouse, drying room, 
dressing room and other public life space. Each seafarer must have an individual sleeping room. 
Tableware, including plates, cups, and other mess utensils，service utensils must be made of an approved 
material which can be easily clean. Company must provide seafarers with clean tableware to be used 
onboard when at the service of the vessel. Company must provide free towels, soap and toilet paper for 
seafarers. Company must provide seafarers with laundry services conveniently located and furnished 
that include washing machines, drying machines or adequately heated and ventilated drying rooms, 
irons and ironing boards or their equivalent. A separate hospital accommodation is set up. Used 
exclusively for medical purposes. It cannot be used for any other purpose. 
3.1.3 公司充分考虑到船员起居舱室的面积、层高、隔音、隔热、减震、自然采光和人工照
明、室内家具以及其它有益于船员身心健康和生活便利的因素，并 24 小时不间断地
保持良好的通风、舒适的室温和湿度、充足的照明 (包括应急照明)、生活冷热水供
应和排放、卫生设施的正常使用，免费提供卧具的清洁消毒和卫生用品的发放。空调
易于清洗和消毒，以预防和控制病毒的扩散。 
Company takes into full consideration of area, floor height, sound insulation, heat insulation, shock 
absorption, natural light and artificial light of accommodation, indoor furniture and other facts being 
beneficial to seafarer health and convenience, and maintains 24-hours well ventilation, comfortable 
temperature and humidity, adequate light (including emergency lighting)，supply and discharging of 
cool and hot water，use of sanitary facility, and provides free cleaning and sterilization of bedding and 
drug sundries. Air conditioning is easy to clean and disinfection, in order to prevent or control the 
propagation of diseases.  
3.1.4 船舶起居舱室维护管理情况由船长或其指定人员负责监督检查，每周至少检查一次，
一般在周日进行填写“船舶生活、娱乐设施及卫生检查表”，以确保船员起居舱室的
干净和体面地适宜居住。“船舶生活、娱乐设施及卫生检查表” 由船长签署，在船保
存，保存期至少为一年。 
Maintenance of ship accommodation shall be checked by master or other authorized person at least once 
a week, check results shall be recorded onto Checklist of Living Recreational Facilities and Sanitation 
Onboard(as per appendix 5) to ensure condition of seafarer accommodation is clean and decent. 
checklist of living，recreational facilities and sanitation onboard shall signed by master and keep

3.2 娱乐设施  
    Recreational facilities

积的场地，供不当班的海员休息之用； 
All ships shall have a space or spaces on open deck to which the seafarers can have access when off 
duty, which are of adequate area having regard to the size of the ship and the number of seafarers on 
board; 
3.2.2 应至少包括一个书架和供阅读和书写设施，以及在实际可行时，游戏设施； 
Furnishings for recreational facilities should as a minimum include a bookcase and facilities for reading, 
writing and, where practicable, games; 
3.2.3 可设立一个小卖部； 
Give consideration to the provision of a canteen; 
3.2.4 船舶娱乐设施包括多功能餐厅、娱乐室、阅览室、健身房等以及为这些场所配备视听
器材、影视资料、运动器材、图书、报刊杂志、各种棋牌和其它益智文体活动用品； 
Recreational facilities shall include multi-function mess room, entertainment room, reading room, 
gymnasium, and be fitted with viewing and hearing equipment, film and video，sports equipment, books, 
news paper and magazine, kinds of chess and cards and other helpful facilities; 
3.2.5 公司充分考虑到船员业余文化生活以及其它有益于船员身心健康因素，为船舶配备电

The company takes into sufficient consideration of the spare time life of seafarers and the facts 
beneficial to seafarer health, equips TV, film and video player, sound facility and body-building 
equipment on board ship, regularly provides films, TV drama, art play, videos relating to law and 
special interview, and kinds of news paper and magazine, entertainment facilities；the company ensures 
that the forwarding and readdressing of seafarers' mail、internal is as reliable and expeditious as 
possible； seafarers can use ship satellite telephone with reasonable charge; 
3.2.6 船舶娱乐设施维护管理情况由船长或其指定人员负责监督检查，每周不少于一次，一

3.3 食品与饮食 
Food and catering 
3.3.1 公司为船员免费提供能充分满足船员健康、宗教需求、文化习俗，以及航程考虑因素
在质量、营养价值、数量和品种方面的食品和饮用水。 
The company provides free food and drinking water to crew members that fully meets their health, 
religious, cultural and customary needs, as well as taking into account factors related to the voyage in 
terms of quality, nutritional value, quantity and variety.  
3.3.2 公司充分考虑到船员的体面生活，为船舶配备用于储存和处理食物和饮用水的所有场
所和设备、用于准备和供应餐食的厨房以及餐具柜、消毒柜、饮用水过滤装置和洗涤
餐具池等其它设备。 
The company takes into sufficient consideration of decent living condition for seafarers，equips 
locations and equipments for storing and processing foods and drinking water, galley for preparing and 
supplying catering, and other facilities such as lockers for mess utensils, sterilization lockers，drinking 
water filter，pool for washing utensils on board. 
3.3.3 公司为所管理船舶选派符合海上工作资格并经过培训获得认可机构签发的合格证书
的厨师，证书原件应在船保存以备港口国检查。如需要该厨师合格证书需得到船旗国
主管机关的认可。上船任职前必须通过有资质的体检单位中合格医师对从事炊饮工作
人员的专项健康检查。 
The company will assign cooker who is fit to the qualif1cation of performing duty on board, Original of 
the certificate shall be kept onboard the ship for inspection by port state inspectors. Ships cooks’ 
certificates shall be recognized after assessment by the competent authority of the flag state if any need. 
And has obtained certificate issued by authorized party on board ship, prior to beginning to work on 
board, the cooker shall examine the special health examination by qualified medical practitioner of 
qualified medical party. 
3.3.4 公司为所管理船舶提供各港口伙食和饮用水供应商信息，要求所属船舶接受具有资质
的供应商提供的食品和饮用水。 
The company provides the information of foods and drinking water supplier of every port and asks 
every ship shall accept foods and drinking water from qualified supplier. 
3.3.5 船舶应建立由本船船员组成的伙食管理委员会，对公司支付船舶伙食费的收支、伙食
采购计划、食品的保质保鲜储存管理、船员膳食的计划和营养平衡 (周食谱)等具有
监督管理职能。 
A food management committee shall be set up by seafarers to monitor and manage the income and 
outcome of cost of foods, foods purchasing plan, storage of foods, catering plan and nutrition balance 
(weekly menu). 
3.3.6 船舶的食品和饮用水管理情况由船长或其指定人员负责监督检查，每周至少检查一
次，一般在周日进行，填写“船舶生活、娱乐设施及卫生检查表”以保持船员的营养
平衡和饮食安全。 
Management of food and drinking water shall be checked by master or other authorized person at least 
once a week, check results shall be recorded onto Checklist of Living, Recreational Facility And 
Sanitation (as per appendix 6) to maintain the seafarers' nutrition and catering safety. 
3.3.7 开航前根据航程时间和在船船员人数检查食品和饮用水储备，确保符合船员营养平
衡。 
Prior to sailing，according to the sailing distance and manning level，storage of food and drinking water 
shall be checked to ensure the nutrition of seafarers is balanced. 
3.3.8 检查中如出现不符合项必须在检查表对应部分列出纠正措施，公司根据船舶要求提供

3.3.9 膳食尊重不同的文化和宗教背景船员（如有）。 
Prepare food with respect to certain culture and religion backgrounds (if any). 
3.3.10 伙食管理的职责分工 
The work division of food management  
3.3.10.1 船长的职责 
Duties of the captain 
 领导和监督船舶伙食和饮用水的管理工作，监督船舶伙食和饮用水的供应、存储，
监督食品和饮用水存放处所的设备维护保养及卫生情况，以确保船员饮食安全，
保障船员身体健康。指导船舶伙委会工作，杜绝伙食浪费和损坏，保障伙食账目
的透明。 
The management of food and drinking water should be implemented under the leadership of the 
master by supervising the supply and storage of food and drinking water and maintenance and 
sanitation of equipments used for the storage to ensure the food safety and healthy, by giving 
guidance to the food management committee on board to eliminate food waste and spoilage and 
ensure the food expenditure account transparent. 
 负责组织成立船舶伙委会。 
Set up the food management committee on board 
 每月组织召开伙委会工作会议。研究、审核伙食账目，督促伙食管理工作的改进。 
Organize to convene the food management committee’s meetings every month to research and audit 
the food account, and to supervise the work improvement of food management. 
3.3.10.2 大副的职责 
Duties of the chief officer 
 负责对船上厨房、冰库、伙食及饮用水储存处所的卫生每周进行定期检查并保存
检查记录。 
Carry out documented inspections regularly with respect to galley，freezer store and storage of food 
and drinking water. 
 对上述处所进行检查和维护保养 
Carry out inspections and maintenance to the above spaces. 
3.3.10.3 伙委会的组成和职责 
The makeup and duty of food management committee 
a. 伙委会由大厨、电机员、水手长、机工长、三副、三管轮组成。电机员任伙委
会主任。三副和三管轮每2 个月轮流管理伙食账目，负责对伙食票据进行审核，
凭伙委会成员会签的伙食单证报领现金；保存伙食账表；每月5 日前或每航次
公布伙食的收支情况；发生伙食采购后，应公示伙食采购情况； 
The food management committee is made of 6 people including cook, electrician, boatswain, 
fitter, third deck officer and fourth Engineer. Electrician serves as the director of the committee. 
The third deck officer and fourth Engineer are in charge of handling the food accounts, auditing 
food bills, drawing cash by documents signed by the committee members and keeping the food 
accounts. The income and outcome of cost of foods should be published before 5th every month 
or every voyages. And the food purchase shall be public reviewed once happened. 
b. 伙委会在船长的领导下，审核大厨的航次伙食计划，并报船长批准；负责伙食
供应商的确定、价格的洽谈及对伙食入库前质量和数量的检查、监督，并在购
买伙食单证上签字确认。参加每月的伙食盘点及伙食管理会议，征求船员意见
制定纠正措施，并接受船员的监督、检查。

The food management committee, under the leadership of the master, is in responsible for 
auditing the food purchasing plan of each voyage, reporting to the master for approval, choosing

c. 伙委会主任负责伙委会活动的组织、记录，向船长报告有关情况，保存由船长

The director of the committee is responsible for organization and records of meetings, reports to

The director is entitled to report problems arising in the food management over tracking the food 
arrangement. 
3.3.10.4 大厨的职责 
Duties of the cook 
 在船长的领导下，全面负责船舶炊事工作。包括对伙食库和厨房炊具的管理卫生
工作；每天检查伙食仓库，对库存的伙食予以妥善保管，防止食品变质、损坏。 
The cook takes complete charge of all the cooking work on board under the leadership of the master, 
including the sanitary management of food storage and mess utensils. To check to the food storage 
everyday and keep the food in storage with due care to prevent spoilage and damage. 
 根据船长的指示，及时制定航次伙食采购计划，交伙委会审核，报船长批准； 
To make food purchasing plan of a voyage timely according to the directive of the master, hand in to 
the food management committee for review and then report to the master for approval。 
 参与伙食的采购、验收、入库及整理工作；负责伙食出入库的登记； 
Involve in the purchasing, receiving inspection, inventory and arrangement. Be in charge records of 
food storage.  
 负责周食谱的制定，领导其他厨工，落实周食谱。负责日常膳食配制和烹饪工作，
对伙食的质量负责； 
Make the weekly menu and implement it accordingly by leading other cook. In attendance of the 
daily catering and cooking, be responsible for the quality of the food. 
 在特殊情况下，如船员备舱、抢修、加班、靠离泊位等作业时，要积极主动为船
员提供必要的伙食保证； 
Actively provide the necessary meal for crews in special case such as emergency repair, overtime 
work, mooring, departing and changing to another berth.  
 负责保存周食谱，保存期一年。 
Keep weekly menu for one year. 
3.3.11 对船上厨房、冰库、食品及饮用水存放场所的管理标准。 
Management standard of galley, freezer store, food and drinking water onboard. 
3.3.11.1 船上厨房、冰库、食品及饮用水存放场所的设备应定期做好检查和维护。 
The equipment in galley, freezer store, and for storage food and drinking water should be inspected 
periodically.   
3.3.11.2 船上饮食及存放场所的状况及卫生应符合以下标准： 
The condition of food and storage on board should comply with the following requirements: 
 厨房：保持干净、无虫害，随时有冷热水可用，排水畅通，冰箱工作正常、干净，
滴油盘经常清洁，地砖和墙面瓷砖无损坏。 
Galley should be clean, pest-free，with available hot and cold running fresh water and properly 
drainage. The refrigerator is working in order and kept clean. The drip tray should be cleaned

 干食品储藏库内有有效通风，无虫害。

3.3.12 伙食计划及采购程序 
 Catering plan and purchasing procedures 
3.3.12.1 航次开始前，船长应将航次情况、目的港的情况和航次周期通知大厨。大厨应综
合考虑航次周期、船员人数、目的港的情况、营养标准、各类食品的比例等因素，参
考伙委会的意见，填写航次伙食采购计划单，报伙委会审核，送船长批准。 
The master should inform cook the destination and duration of voyages before sailing. And the cook 
shall fill in the plan list of food purchasing for a voyage, based on an overall consideration of the 
manning level, destination and duration of voyages, nutritional standards, the proportion of various food 
and other factors, submit the plan list for the committee’s examination and the master’s approval. 
3.3.12.2 伙食采购工作由伙委会主任负责组织伙委会成员共同参与，包括供应商的选择、谈
价（要明价明扣）、伙食上船与入库的检查与监督。采购和付款等环节必须有至少两
名伙委会成员在场。 
The food purchasing, including choosing the supplier, negotiating price, examination and supervision of 
the foods boarding and storage, is organized by the director of the committee and participated by all the 
committee members. The purchasing and payment require the presence of at least two members of the 
committee. 
3.3.12.3 采购伙食票据，必须有伙委会半数以上成员签字确认。不准签写空白或可以改制的
发票。 
The relevant documents for purchasing food should be signed for confirmation by more than half the 
members of the committee. Signing a blank or changeable invoice shall be prohibited. 
3.3.12.4 国内外供应商给予的回扣应以降价的形式填写在发票上，如属于现金、物品时，
应报告船长，以列为伙食节余，并在伙食采购单上标明公布于众。 
The rebate the domestic suppliers offer shall reflect on the invoice as price reduction. Any cash or items 
rebate shall be reported to the master, listed as food balance, indicated on the food purchasing list and 
made known to the public. 
3.3.12.5 无论在国内还是在国外采购伙食，都必须符合食品卫生标准和检疫规定及港口国
当局要求。 
The food purchasing should be in conformity with the regulation of food hygiene standards and health 
quarantine and the requirements of the local port state. 
3.3.12.6 采购伙食而发生的交通费、运杂费等须计入船舶伙食费内。公司对此不另行报销。 
The transportation cost and freight occurred by purchasing food shall be included in the cost of food, 
which shall not be reimburse by the company. 
3.3.13 伙食验收、入库和出库 
The stock-taking, stock-in and stock-out 
3.3.13.1 采购的伙食在入库前，由大厨及伙委会成员三人以上，根据购货发票（清单）进
行过秤、清点、验收。验收无误后，由大厨和参加验收的伙委会成员共同在发票或收
据上签字，交给三副，并报船长审核签字后方可报销，无验收签字的发票不准报销。

Before stock-in, all the food should be weighed, counted and inspected according to the purchasing list 
by the cook and more than 3 members of the food management committee, who shall sign on the 
invoice or receipt together, hand in to the third deck officer and report the master for reimbursement. An 
invoice without acceptance of signature shall not be reimbursed. 
3.3.13.2 伙食入库前要做适当的分类，如有必要进行再包装。入库的伙食由大厨填写入库
登记表，记录入库时间、品名、数量、单价、保鲜（保质）期、总费用、库存量、入
库人签字等项目。 
The food shall be classified before stock-in, re-packaged if necessary. The cook shall fill in the 
registration form of inventory, indicating the date, name, quantity, unit price, shelf life, total cost, stocks, 
signature and other items.  
3.3.13.3 购买伙食的详细账目（价格、数量）要在伙食入库后五天内张贴在餐厅（保留至
少在一个月以上），以便所有船员了解伙食采购情况。 
The detailed food accounts, including price and quantity, shall be post on the mess room in five days 
after stock-in, which should be reserved for at least more than one month for all crew’s information of 
the food purchasing. 
3.3.13.4 所有伙食的出库，均由大厨填写出库单，登记出库时间、品名、数量、用途、单
价、金额等，由领取人（包括大厨本人）签字确认。 
The cook shall fill in a delivery note, registering the date, name, quantity, purpose, unit price, total price 
and other items, which require the signature of both recipient and the cook for confirmation. 
3.3.14 伙食烹饪 
Cooking  
3.3.14.1 大厨烹饪时应特别注意考虑船员的民族、宗教及饮食习惯的特别要求。 
The cook shall take into account the special requirements of different ethnic group religious 
backgrounds and eating habits when cooking. 
3.3.14.2 大厨应检查食品质量，严禁烹饪腐烂变质食品。如因此造成船员生病，公司将对
大厨给予严肃处理。 
The cook should check the quality of the food. To cook with the spoiled food is strictly prohibited, by 
which any crew’s illness caused, the company will deal sternly with the cook. 
3.3.14.3 每星期六上午，将大厨编制的下周食谱，报请船长批准后，张贴公布并监督执行；
周食谱由船长签字确认，交回大厨保存，以备公司检查。 
The cook should prepare the menu for next week in the morning of every Saturday, report the master for 
approval and post it to publicize. The weekly menu is signed by the master for confirmation, returned 
the cook for company’s inspection. 
3.3.14.4 大厨对主食及菜式的安排，应考虑到营养的均衡及船舶的生活环境等因素。 
The arrangement of main food and dishes should take into account to the balance of diet and the living 
condition on ship and other factors. 
3.3.14.5 每日三餐中，早餐应一周不重样（应包括牛奶、果汁、矿泉水等饮品），午餐和晚
餐应不少于三菜一汤（饺子、包子除外），周末和节假日应适当增加菜式和菜量；餐
桌上要及时供应各种调味品及牙签、餐巾纸等用品。 
In three meals a day, breakfast should be different in one week, including milk, juice, mineral water and 
other drinks, lunch and dinner supplied should not be less than three dishes and one soup, dumplings 
and steamed buns excluded in weekends and holidays, the variety of dishes and the amount of food 
should be increased; timely supply a variety of spices and toothpicks, napkins and other supplies on the 
table. 
3.3.14.6 在条件允许的情况下，尽可能为船员提供各类水果、饮料以保证维生素和矿物质
的摄入；为方便船员，可适当发放水果费。

3.3.14.7 夜间22:00 以后靠离泊或加班工作，由部门长通知厨房为加班船员准备夜餐。 
The head of the department should inform the cook to prepare a night snack for the crew if the ship is 
approaching or leaving the shore or overtime work needed after 22:00. 
3.3.14.8 工作时间，炊事人员必须穿戴整洁的厨师服装，不得有光脚、穿背心、短裤、拖
鞋、抽烟等不端行为。 
During work hours, the cook should be in chef’s uniform. Any misconduct such as barefoot, wearing a 
vest, shorts, slippers or smoking is forbidden. 
3.3.15 食品库存管理 
The management of the food storage 
3.3.15.1 所有的食品要分类贮存，蔬菜在入库前要分类存放，对于精菜要加保鲜袋；新上
的肉类要进行适当的分割，然后装入保鲜袋速冻；各类伙食都不允许直接堆放在地上；
不准使用有色的塑料袋盛食品。 
All the food should be stored by categories. The fine vegetable shall be wrapped with poly bags. The 
fresh meat shall be cut into appropriate parts and put into the poly bags for quick-freezes. It is 
prohibited to pile the food on the ground or to store food with colored plastic bags. 
3.3.15.2 每次补充伙食前，大厨应将冷库洗涮干净。副食品库及粮食库均应打扫清洁，并
整理。 
The cook should clean the cold storage，non-staple foods storage and grain storage before supply food. 
3.3.15.3 大厨对冷库的温度每天至少检查两次（可结合取伙食时进行）。发现问题时应及时
与轮机部联系。对于有独立的肉库和鱼库的船舶，应将鱼类与肉类分开储存、保管。 
The cook should check the temperature of the cold storage at least twice a day and advise the technical 
department if there’s any problem. The fish and meat should be stored separately if the ship is equipped 
with separate fish storage and meat storage. 
3.3.15.4 所有的食品要勤检查、勤整理、勤调换。先购的伙食应优先食用，防止因储存过
久而霉烂变质。应对伙食库定期灭虫、灭鼠。 
All the food should be inspected, sorted out and exchanged frequently.  Priority to use the food 
purchased early to prevent deterioration from being stored for a long period of time. Anti-rodent and 
anti-pest campaigns should be carried out periodically. 
3.3.15.5 库存的伙食要定期盘点。每月末或每航次由伙委会盘点一次，并做好记录 
并及时公布盘点情况。 
The food management committee shall take inventory at the end of month or each round voyage, keep 
the records and make it public. 
3.3.16 伙食交接 
Hand-over of food 
3.3.16.1 船舶采购伙食时，应与伙食消耗有机结合起来统筹考虑，除特殊情况外，尽量避
免在大量船员换班时，留有大量的库存伙食。 
      Give due consideration to the food consumption when purchasing food except in special cases. It should 
be avoided to leave a large quantity of food in stock when there is a large number of crew-change. 
3.3.16.2 船长、大厨交班前，伙委会成员应在将准备移交给接班人员的库存伙食进行盘点，
包括伙食的品种、数量、单价、总价等，列出明细清单。对于变质食品也应列出明细
清单，在交班前的船员伙食费中予以扣除，并公布于众。对于变质食品，应及时进行
清理。

inventory of the food in stock, including name, quantity, unit price and other items, list details including

07_8_0.text:
第四章 健康和安全 
Chapter 04 Health and Safety 
4.1 卫生 
    Sanitation 
4.1.1 公司为船员提供符合安全、健康、卫生的船舶环境。船舶应持有有效的卫生证书。 
The company provides safe，healthy and sanitary work environment to seafarers，Valid sanitary 
certificate shall be available on board ship. 
4.1.2 公司充分考虑到船员身心健康和环境卫生等因素，要求船舶保持与主管当局签发的卫
生证书相符合的船员起居和饮食生活卫生环境。 
The company will takes into sufficient consideration of factors pertaining to seafarer' health and work 
environment，request the ship to maintain a sanitary living and catering environment which is 
complying with the sanitary certificate issued by competent authority. 
4.1.3 船舶和个人卫生包括 (但不限于)个人起居舱室、厨房餐厅等生活区公共场所的清洁无
虫害，室内流动空气的质量，舒适的环境温度和湿度，船员食品和饮用水的安全卫生，
生活冷热水 24 小时供应和通畅排放，各个卫生设施的完好，垃圾处理规范和个人卫
生讲究等。 
Public and private sanitation includes (but not limited to) cleanness and lack of insect pest of private 
accommodation，galley and mess room，quality of indoor flowing air，comfortable temperature and 
humidity of environment, sanitation of food and drinking water, 24-hours supply and free-flowing 
discharge of cool and hot water, completeness of sanitary facilities, proper garbage disposition and 
exquisite personal sanitation. 
4.1.4 职责分工 
Division of responsibilities 
4.1.4.1 船长：负责船舶生活及娱乐设施管理工作的监督和健康和安全保护及事故预防。船
长每周要组织大副、轮机长检查全船卫生及生活、娱乐设施状况，填写《船舶生活、
娱乐设施及卫生检查表》，并在OFFICIAL LOG BOOK 中记录卫生检查时间。 
The master is responsible for health and safety protection and accident prevention ,Supervising the 
management of the living and recreational facilities, organizing the chief officer and the chief engineer 
to inspect the sanitation of the ship and the condition of the living and recreational facilities, checking 
result shall be recorded onto the Living and Recreational Facilities and Sanitation Checklist. The time 
of the sanitation inspection should be marked onto the OFFICIAL LOG BOOK. 
4.1.4.2 大副：负责本部门健康和安全保护及事故预防,工作区域的卫生管理工作及船舶生活
区公共卫生的日常管理和检查；包括安排生活区楼道、走廊、墙壁、公共卫生间、
公共洗澡间、洗衣房、医务室、理货房及娱乐设施等的卫生整理工作。负责生活、
娱乐设施的检查和维护保养。 
The chief officer is responsible for health and safety protection and accident prevention ,the sanitation 
management and inspection of the workplace of his own department and public life space, including 
corridor， passageway, walls, public washroom, public bathroom, laundry, hospital accommodation 
and recreational facilities. Be responsible for the inspection and maintenance of recreational facilities. 
4.1.4.3 轮机长：负责本部门健康和安全保护及事故预防、卫生管理工作。 
The chief engineer is  responsible for the health and safety protection and accident prevention 、
hygiene control of the workplace of his own department.       
4.1.4.4 服务生：具体负责船长、轮机长、大副、大管轮房间及船舶公共场所（餐厅、配餐
间、洗碗间、娱乐室、引水房、船东房间等）的日常管理及卫生工作；协助大厨整
理厨房、伙食库。 
Steward is responsible for the daily hygiene work in the cabin of the master, chief engineer, chief

Seafarer is responsible for the hygiene of his own cabin and washroom and the work arranged by the

4.1.5 卫生标准 
Standards of hygiene 
4.1.5.1 船员房间： 
Crew cabins: 
 地面、桌面、墙面干净、整洁，无油迹和水痕、无灰尘、无破损； 
The floor，tops of tables and walls should be clean and tidy without grease mark, water streak, dust

The doors, windows, curtains and door handles should be clean and tidy. 
 房间无异味、有足够的照明； 
The room should be provided with frequent lighting，without any smell. 
 沙发、座椅等无破损； 
The sofas, tables and chairs are in perfect condition and without damage.

The beddings should be clean and stacked in neat folds

象、地面无积水、无垃圾；脸盆及马桶洁净；洗漱用品保持整洁、摆放有序。

flushing system, without leakage, standing water and garbage on the floor. The sink, toilet and 
toiletries should be kept clean and orderly. 
 房间内无私拉电线、违规使用电器情况。 
It is not allowed to implicate wiring or usage of facilities without previous permission.  
4.1.5.2 厨房、餐厅、配餐间： 
Galley, mess room and pantry: 
 无蚊蝇、蟑螂、油垢；

 排水管畅通； 食品库：干净整洁。无异味，无鼠患、虫害。 
 Drains must be kept clear. The pantry is clean without any smell, rodent or pest.

Hospital accommodation

Pantry: 
 每周整理菜库、肉库、干货库；食品应放置在货架上，离地板距离不少于6 英寸
（15 厘米以上），不得置放在地板上； 
Clean the pantry every week. The food should be placed in the shelf at least 6 inches above the 
floor.  
 每天进出库时检查库房温度，及时整理，防止腐烂霉变； 
Check the temperature of the pantry and tidy it everyday to avoid food deterioration. 
 腐烂食物按垃圾处理规定及时处理； 
Spoiled food should be dealt with as per the requirements of waste disposal. 
 过期食品要及时处理，不得保存在食品库内。 
Expired food should be dealt with immediately and not stored in the pantry. 
4.1.5.8 生活区走廊及墙壁： 
Corridors and walls in the living area 
 保持清洁， 
Keep clean 
 每次抵港前两天要在楼道走廊进行适当铺垫，离港后整理入库； 
The corridor should be paved by mat 2 days before arrival at port. The mats should be put back 
after departure. 
4.1.5.9 引水房/船东房间： 
Pilot room and owner room 
 抵港口前一天整理清洁房间卫生、配置生活必需品； 
Clean the cabin and provide life’s necessities one day before arriving port 
 房间在来人前和人员走后要通风换气。 
The room should be ventilated before and after visiting 
4.1.5.10 公共卫生间： 
Public washroom 
 保持每天清洁至少一次； 
 Keep cleaned at least once a day 
 保持马桶洁净，无异味，冲水系统正常。 
Keep the toilet cleaned and free of bad odours. The flushing systems function well. 
4.1.5.11 船长、轮机长、大副、大管轮房间： 
 The cabin of the master, the chief engineer, the chief officer and the second engineer officer 
 办公室的招待烟、饮料、纸巾盒等摆放整齐，水杯干净无水渍、茶垢； 
The tobacco, drink, napkin holder and other stuff in the office should be placed in order. The water 
glasses should be clean without watermark and coloring. 
 在港期间每天至少二次整理、清洁，并根据来访人员情况随时清洁整理； 
The cabin should be cleaned at least twice a day during berthing and tidied up at any time 
according to the guests’ situation. 
 航行期间每天至少一次整理、清洁； 
Clean and tidy the cabin at least once a day during voyage。 
 每周清洁一次冰箱内物品；金属包装食品开启后储藏需更换包装。 
Clean the stuff in the refrigerator once a week. Food with metal packaging should change another 
package once opened.

07_8_1.text:

4.1.5.12 船员房间： 
Crew’s cabin 
 每天打扫房间、整理房间物品，清洁卫生间； 
Clean and tidy the cabin and the washroom everyday.  
 保持马桶洁净，无异味。 
Keep the toilet clean and free of bad odor。 
4.1.5.13 工作场所： 
Workplace 
 全船的工作场所卫生由工作场所所在的部门安排进行定期的清理。船舶工作场所
要保持整齐洁净，无油渍和堆积物，禁止吸烟。 
The workplace should be cleaned regularly be the department that works at the workplace. The 
workplace on the ship should be kept clean and in order, without grease spots and accumulation of 
objects or rubbish. Smoking is forbidden in the workplace. 
 工作场所在做完修理等作业后要随即清洁干净，产生的各种垃圾要按照垃圾分类
方法放入指定容器内，不得乱丢，乱放； 
The workplace should be cleaned immediately after repair operation. All kinds of wastes generated 
should be classified and put into the specified container according to the garbage classification 
method. Don’t throw the garbage anywhere. 
 工作场所作业完后，使用过的工具要清洁干净，放回原位。 
The tool used should be cleaned and put back after finishing operation in the workplace. 
 工作场所作业完后，不再使用的设备旧件要放置到合适的位置，进行适当的系固，
防止风浪天移动。 
 The equipment or pieces that are no longer use should be put in an appropriate place and secured 
to avoid movement in storm days. 
 确保工作场所安全隐患得以纠正，受热面予以防护保证安全。工作场所不应存在
不安全因素。 
Ensure hidden trouble in the workplace could be rectified and the heating surface is protected for 
safety. The workplace should not be unsafe. 
 船长、轮机长、大副、大管轮对工作场所的卫生状况定期进行检查、评估。 
The master, chief engineer, chief officer and the second engineer officer should inspect and 
evaluate the hygiene conditions of the workplace regularly. 
4.1.6 卫生用品配备 
Provide sanitary articles 
卫生用品由公司配备并负担费用。 
The sanitary articles should be provide and bear the expenses by the company 
4.1.7 船舶和个人卫生管理情况由船长或其指定人员负责监督检查，每周至少检查一次，一
般在周日进行，填写“船舶生活、娱乐设施及卫生检查表”，以保持船舶的卫生环境
和船员的身心健康。 
Management of public and private sanitation sha11 be checked by master or other authorized person at 
least once a week，check results shall be recorded onto <checklist of living and recreational facilities 
and sanitation> (as per appendix 8) to maintain the sanitation of ship and seafarers' heath. 
4.1.8 检查中如出现不符合项必须在检查表对应部分列出纠正措施，公司根据船舶要求提供
必要的技术和物质支持；检查表必须注明纠正结果 (船舶自身纠正或公司支持纠正)
和完成时间。 
For any nonconformity, corrective action shall be listed on the checklist, and the company shall provide 
necessary technical and financial support accordingly；Result of corrective action (by ship or by 
company) and completed time shall be marked on the checklist.

4.2 防疫 
   Disease prevention  
4.2.1 公司为船员健康提供防疫预警、防疫物资和船员防疫接种。 
The company will provide disease prevention early warning, disease prevention goods and disease 
prevention inoculation for all seafarers on board ship. 
4.2.2 为保障船员的身体健康，船舶应在抵达港口选择有资质的供应商补充食品和饮用水，
关注和收集各抵达港口的疫情情况，保持与公司的联系，在公司的指导下，正确使用
防疫器材和采取必要的防疫措施。 
To protect the seafarers' health, food and drinking water shall be supplied by qualified supplier when in 
port, epidemic situation of the port shall be focused on and collected, and the ship shall keep in touch 
with the company, accurately use disease prevention facility and take necessary disease prevention 
action under the direction of the company. 
4.2.3 船舶应保证在船船员国际接种证书在有效期内，一旦发现逾期，必须立即通知抵达港
口代理办理接种手续。 
International inoculation certificate of all seafarers shall be in the period of validity, where expires，the 
port agency shall be informed immediately to carry out inoculation issues. 
4.3 医疗 
Medical care 
4.3.1 公司为船员提供尽可能相当于岸上工人一般能够得到的健康保护和医疗，包括迅速使
用诊断和治疗所必需的药品、医疗设备和设施和在船舶停靠港口时，应尽可能地给予
船员下地去看合格医生或牙医的机会。 
The company provides health protection and medical care on board as comparable as possible to that 
which is generally available to workers ashore, including prompt access to necessary medicine, medical 
equipment and facility for diagnosis and treatment, seafarers shall be given a right to visit a qualified 
medical doctor or dentist in ports of call, where practicable. 
4.3.2 公司充分考虑到船员身体健康，为船舶配备的大副都经过《STCW95 公约》所要求的
医疗急救业务合格培训，作为兼职船医负责船员的健康保护和船舶药品管理，正确进
行常规医疗急救和正确使用主管当局要求的标准医疗报告格式向岸上医生表述。 
By taking into consideration of health of seafarers, a chief officer with the approved medical first-aid 
training required by STCW95 will be assigned on board ship, who is responsible for medical care on 
board ship, medicine management, conduct regular medical first-aid and correctly use the standard 
medical report form required by competent authority to report to doctor ashore. 
4.3.3 公司为船舶配备最新版本的《国际船舶医疗指南》、《国际信号规则》以及《减少船上
骚扰和欺凌的导则》等书籍。大副应具备获得医疗指导能力以及通过《国际信号规则》
的医疗部分了解所需要的咨询医生及相关信息的技能。船舶卫星通讯系统各有一份最
新的能获得医疗指导的岸上地面站的完整清单，保证及时获取岸上医疗机构提供的指
导意见。 
The latest edition of International Medical Guide, the International Code of Signals ，and the Guidance 
on eliminating shipboard harassment and bullying as well as the similar national guides will be 
available on board ship. The chief officer shall be competent on medical advice capability, aware of the 
medical section of the International Code Of Signals and related information. A complete and 
up-to-date list of coast earth station shall be available, through which medical advice information can be 
obtained in time. 
4.3.4 船舶载运危险品时，船上应各有针对此类危险品专用解毒剂和个人保护装置，并配备
《用于涉及危险品事故的医疗急救指南》，向船员提供关于该物质的性质、存在的风
险的信息和必要的个人保护装置。 
When dangerous goods are carried, specif1c antidotes and personal protective devices shall be on

board，the nature of the substance，the risk involved and necessary personal protective devices shall be 
made available to the seafarers according to the Medical First-Aid Guide for Use in Accidents Involving 
Dangerous Goods. 
4.3.5 船舶的医务室由大副负责管理，必须专用，供船员发生伤病时进行观察、诊断、治疗
和隔离的场所，不得挪作他用。病房及其设施必须保持能随时接受伤、病员的状态及
清洁卫生环境。船舶医务室必须配有专用的卫生间，既可作为医务室的一部分也可就
近设置，并至少应包括一个厕所、一个洗脸池和一个浴盆或淋浴。 
Chief officer shall manage the hospital and ensure it is for an exclusive use for medical observation, 
diagnosis, treatment and quarantine when seafarers are ill or injured. Hospital and facilities shall be 
maintained for the purpose to receive patient at any time and be clean and sanitary. Sanitary 
accommodation should be provided for the exclusive use of the occupants of the hospital 
accommodation, either as part of the accommodation or in close proximity thereto. Such sanitary 
accommodation should comprise a minimum of one toilet, one washbasin and one tub or shower. 
4.3.6 公司保证免费向船上海员或在外国港口下船的海员提供健康保护和医疗。 
Ensure that medical care and health protection services while a seafarer is on board ship or landed in a 
foreign port are provided free of charge to seafarers. 
4.3.7 船员在船因疾病所致病故者，公司将根据已故船员亲属的意愿，视情况尽早安排将已
故船员遗体或骨灰运回国内安葬。公司将采取措施保护患病、受伤或死亡的船员遗留
在船上的财物并将其归还给船员的最近亲属。在船船员的所有死亡都应该详细调查和
记录，并向船旗国和成员国报告。 
If seafarer dies of an illness on board，according to the willing of dependents，the company will 
transport the remains or bone ash as soon as possible. Actions will be taken to protect the property left 
by the seafarer and return the property to the nearest relative of the seafarer. All deaths among crew on 
board should be thoroughly investigated and recorded, and reported to the ship's flag state and member 
state. 
4.3.8 船上的医疗配备 
船舶药品、医疗器械、敷料及刊物的配备参照船旗国政府的相关规定及《国际船 
舶医疗指南》（INTERNATIONAL MEDICAL GUIDE FOR SHIPS）的要求执行。同时
考虑到船舶目的地、航程时间和船舶人数进行配置。 
Medical facilities onboard 
The medicine, medical apparatus, dressings and publication should be supplied according to the 
regulation of the government of the flag state and the requirement in International Medical Guide for 
Ships, taking into account the distance to destination, sailing time and manning level. 
4.3.9 药品及器具的管理 
Medicine and apparatus/equipment management   
4.3.9.1 船上的药品和医疗器具的管理由大副负责； 
The chief officer is in charge of administering medicine and medical apparatus equipment on the ship; 
4.3.9.2 各轮必须备足常用药品，药品的种类和数量应考虑船员伤病的特点和船舶航次特
点。船舶常用药品及医疗器具由大副负责向船管部申请供应。所提供的医疗物品应
有原厂包装、用法、剂量、有效期和生产厂家；药品以小剂量的规格为宜；船舶所
配备的药品器械，应由供应方提供药品器械合格证书（中英文）； 
The ship must be equipped with enough basic medicine, whose varieties and quantities shall take into 
account the particular characteristics of seafarers’ injuries and illness and duration of voyage. The 
chief officer is in charge of applying for basic medicine and medical equipment from Technical 
Department. All medicines, preferably be small dose, should be provided with original packaging, 
directions for usage, expiry dates and manufacturer. For medical equipment should be provided with 
Certificate of Competency bilingual both in Chinese and English;

07_8_2.text:

4.3.9.3 麻醉药品及精神类药品的管理、使用按《船舶手册》第四节“船舶禁毒、麻醉药品
和酒类工作的规定”及《国际船舶医疗指南》的要求执行。船舶抵达港口时必须如
实向海关申报库存的麻醉药品。船舶停靠港口使用麻醉药品前应得到当地海关的批
准； 
The management and usage of narcotics and psychotropic drugs should be in compliance with the 
Provision of Ship Narcotics Drugs and Alcohol, described in section VI of Ship Manual, and 
requirement of International Medical Guide for Ships. The ship shall declare the inventory of the 
narcotics drugs to the Customs upon ship’s arrival in port. The use of narcotics should get the approval 
of the local Customs firstly; 
4.3.9.4 船舶运输危险货物的药品配备； 
Medicine equipment when the ship carries dangerous cargo； 
4.3.9.5 如果船舶运输危险货物，应根据相关公约要求配备相应的特效药品和专用设备，和
普通药品器械一致储存和登记； 
When carrying dangerous cargo, the ship shall be equipped with specific remedy and specified 
equipment, which would be stored and registered in accordance with the basic medicine and 
equipment; 
4.3.9.6 药品和医疗器具的购买、消耗、过期药品的处理，应予以记录； 
Records should be kept when purchasing medicines and medical equipment, medicine consumption 
and dealing with expired medicine; 
4.3.9.7 药品和器具应存放整齐、定期整理，并填报“药品和医疗器具清单”，整理、检查
间隔最长不得超过三个月； 
The medicine and equipment should be kept in order, sort out and inspected at an interval at least not 
less than 3 months，which should be recorded in List Of Medicine And Medical Equipment ; 
4.3.9.8 受控的药品（主要指有小量镇静或麻醉作用的抗生素类和止痛类药品）应分开存放
在无人时房间可上锁的柜子里，最好存放在船长的保险柜里； 
The controlled drugs, especially in reference to the antibiotic and analgesic medicine with sedative or 
anesthetic effects, should be stored in a cabinet of a room which is able to be locked when nobody is 
by. It is best to store in the master’s safe; 
4.3.9.9 所有药品应有效防潮，防温度过高或过低，正常保持15-25 度。如有药品需要冷藏，
应在药房或附近配备一个冰箱专用并能上锁； 
All the medicine should be kept impervious to damp，15-25 degrees normally, neither too high nor too 
low. A lockable refrigerator only for cold storage of medicine shall be equipped in or near the drug 
room if there is a need; 
4.3.9.10 药品的外包装应标明药品的通用名称、剂量，如果标签难以辨认，或容器已打开
过的，或外包装没有标签，或容器不能辨认，这样的药品应按过期药品处理； 
In the outer packing shall be indicated the adopted name of the drug and dosage. The medicine shall 
be dealt as expired drugs if the label is illegible, the container has been opened, there is no label on the 
outer packing or the container is unrecognizable; 
4.3.9.11 药品和医疗器具至少每季度清单更新一次，填报“药品和医疗器具清单”并保存； 
A List Of Medicine And Medical Equipment onboard, which could be record and kept electronically, 
shall be updated at least quarterly; 
4.3.9.12 过期的药品应及时封存，不得放置在医疗室内。在合适港口应交岸处理，同时填
报“过期药品处理清单”并保存该记录； 
The expired medicine is prohibited from keeping in the infirmary. They shall be sealed up 
immediately and forward to the land in the appropriate ports, simultaneously fill in the List for Expired 
Medicines records of which should be kept;

Maritime Labour Management Manual              Version/Revise: 3.0/6.0                             MLM-04

4.3.9.13 大副交接班时，应将“药品及医疗器具清单”列入交接，并签字确认。 
The List of Medicine and Medical Equipment onboard should be included in the hand-over of chief 
officer. The signature for confirmation is required. 
4.3.10 常见伤病的处理 
Treatment of common injuries and diseases 
4.3.10.1 常见伤病的处理可参照的指导执行。船舶对常见伤病的处理可向船员部咨询，船
员部咨询相关专业人员后给予指导； 
For the treatment of common injuries and diseases see International Medical Guide for Ships. The 
ship could consult with the crew department for common injuries. The crew department provides 
guidance after professional consultation; 
4.3.10.2 船员出现伤病（包括必要的牙病）应及时报告船员部，不应延误。经公司同意安
排船员下地就医时，如有必要，船长应将Medical report form for seafarers 表格交由
就医船员携带交医生填写后交回给船长保存。填好后的该表格及其内容应予保密，
只应用于方便海员的治疗，不得出示给其他人员； 
The injuries and diseases, including necessary dental disease, should be reported to the crew 
department without delay, arrange disembarkation for medical treatment after the agreement of the 
company. If necessary, the master should fill up Medical Report Form for Seafarers, which should 
be taken with the patient for the doctor’s records and returned to the master. The medical report is for 
facilitating the treatment only and shall be kept in confidence; 
4.3.10.3 船舶医护记录本。对船员的医护处理和药品的施用情况应在船舶医护记录本中予
以记录，包括船员的症候，用药品种和数量等。填好后的该表格及其内容应予保
密，只应用于方便海员的治疗，不得出示给其他人员。 
The Medical Record Book，on which the medical treatment and use of medicine shall be recorded 
including the symptoms of the patient, the variety and quantity of the medicine used. The filled form 
is for facilitating the treatment only and shall be kept in confidence. 
4.3.11 重伤或急症的处理 
Treatment of seriously injury or emergency   
4.3.11.1 船员出现重伤或急症情况时，船长应采取一切必要措施防止病情恶化； 
The master shall take all necessary measures to prevent the deterioration of the disease when there is a 
seriously injury or emergency. 
4.3.11.2 在未搞清病症情况下，不得盲目用药； 
Don’t use the medicine blindly when the disease is not figured out yet. 
4.3.11.3 船长应毫不犹豫地采取医疗咨询甚至请求医疗救助等救治措施。同时报告公司，
并按《应急计划》中的规定进行操作； 
The master should seek medical advice and help without hesitation, even asked for medical salvation 
or others’ treatment measure etc., report to the company and do in accordance to the Emergency Plan;

Chapter 05  Complain Procedure 
5.1 投诉程序 
Complain procedure 
5.1.1 船员可以对不符合《2006 海事劳工公约》及其修正案和其他相关国际公约、国家
法规、《船员上船就业协议》等规定的行为进行投诉。        
Seafarer shall complain on the activity violating 2006 Maritime Labour Convention and its 
amendments and related provisions of international convention, national law and the Seafarers' 
Employment Agreement. 
5.1.2 船员可以向部门负责人，也可直接向船长、公司或船旗国有关当局，或船员居住
国主管当局提出投诉。海员有权由其在船上选择另一名海员陪同或代表。 
Seafarer can raise complaint to department head, and master, the company or competent authority of 
flag state or the seafarers' country of residence. Seafarer should have the right to be accompanied 
and to be represented by another seafarer of their choice on board. 
5.1.3 部门负责人接到船员投诉后，应尽快接见申诉人，在五天内解决投诉问题。如船
员对投诉的答复不满意，由部门负责人报告船长，由船长亲自处理。 
Upon receiving the complaint，department head shall then attempt to resolve the matter on board the 
ship with 5 days. If the feedback is rejected by the seafarer，department shall report it to the master 
and master shall deal with the complaint. 
5.1.4 船长接到船员投诉应在 24 小时内给予答复。如船员对投诉的答复不满意,  由船
长负责报告公司,如果这个投诉涉及到船长，船员可直接向公司投诉 
Upon receiving the complaint, master shall reply the feedback to seafarer in 24 hours. If the 
feedback is rejected by the seafarer, master shall report it to the company. However, if the complaint 
may be to the prejudice of the master, the seafarer may complain directly to the company. 
5.1.5 公司接到上报的船员投诉后，将立即与申诉人或其指定代表进行协调沟通，应在8
天内给予书面答复。 
Upon receiving the complaint, the company, in consultation with the concerned seafarers or any 
representative they appointed as, shall give a documented answer to seafarer within a period of 8 
days.   
5.1.6 如果8 天内，投诉仍未解决，则该期限可再延长20 天，以找到最为妥善的解决办
法。 
If the complaint on board has not been resolved within the period of 8 days, then the period shall be 
extended for 20 more additional days in order to find a favorable solution. 
5.1.7 对甲方的处理结果仍不满意时，申诉人有权直接向任何有关机构，包括船旗国检
察官，港口国检察官，国外主管当局代表等。如有需要，船长应给予船员方便，
使船员的上诉转达至相关机构。 
If no satisfactory result is achieved, the seafarer concerned have the right to submit directly his 
complaints to any organization he wishes, including the competent authorities, such as flag state 
inspectors, port state inspectors, representatives of the Competent Authority in a foreign country. The 
master shall provide the seafarer such facilities as necessary for the seafarer to transmit his 
complaint to the organization of his choice. 
5.1.8 本投诉程序作为《上船就业协议》的附件，应使每个船员均了解投诉程序内容。
所有投诉和对于投诉所作的结论应在船记录，记录的副本应提供给有关船员。

ensure that each seafarer is aware of the content of the complains procedure. All complains and the
